sections.h2: What is included in every mowing visit
paras: A mowing visit is more than a pass with the mower. We cut to a height that suits the grass type, so kikuyu and couch are kept shorter in summer while tall fescue mixes are left a little longer. Edges along paths, driveways and garden beds are trimmed so the lawn has a clean outline.

Clippings are blown off hard surfaces and bagged. Green waste is removed after every mowing job, so nothing is left in your green bin or piled by the fence. If you want grass mowing Canberra wide that leaves the yard tidy rather than just shorter, this is how we work.

paras: Start with a call to 0423 720 317 or the form below. We ask about the size of the lawn, the grass type and how often you want it cut. Every grass mowing Canberra quote is free and given upfront before we bring a mower through the gate. There are no dollar figures on this page because every lawn is different.

Once you are on the round, we turn up on the agreed cycle without you rebooking. Fortnightly is the most common choice from September to April. Weekly suits fast-growing kikuyu in high summer, and monthly is usually enough from May to August. You can change the frequency at any time. Our aim with grass mowing Canberra wide is simple: taking the headaches away.
bullets: Change frequency with a quick call
One-off cuts before an inspection or sale

paras: Canberra lawns are cool-climate lawns, and grass mowing Canberra wide follows the calendar more than the clock. From September the spring surge kicks in and a missed fortnight leaves a lawn shaggy. Summers are hot and dry, so we avoid scalping and leave more leaf to shade the soil. From May to August hard frosts slow growth, and one visit a month keeps things tidy.

Late winter and spring is also when bindi and broadleaf weeds show up. Mowing helps but does not remove them, so we will point it out if your lawn would benefit from weed spraying or a lawn care program. Autumn leaf drop from deciduous street trees in Weston and Duffy means extra blowing and bagging on those visits.

Most of our work is residential, but we also mow commercial properties, strata common areas and rentals managed by agents. For property managers, grass mowing Canberra rentals on a standing schedule means one less thing to chase tenants about. Lawn mowing services Canberra landlords can hand over entirely, clippings included, suit them well.

faqs.q: Do you offer grass mowing Canberra wide or only in the south?
faqs.a: Our regular rounds are strongest in Weston Creek and Tuggeranong, but we also mow in Woden Valley, Belconnen, the Inner North and Inner South, and in Queanbeyan and Jerrabomberra. Call 0423 720 317 with your suburb and we will confirm a day.

faqs.q: Do you take the grass clippings away?
faqs.a: Yes. Green waste is removed after every grass mowing Canberra job. Clippings are bagged and taken with us, paths are blown clean and your green bin stays free for your own garden waste. This is included in the quote, not an add-on.

faqs.q: How often should my lawn be mowed in summer?
faqs.a: Fortnightly suits most grass mowing Canberra customers from September to April. Kikuyu in full sun in January and February can need a weekly cut. From May to August monthly is usually enough because frost slows growth. We can adjust the schedule whenever you like.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home for the mowing?
faqs.a: No. As long as we can get to the lawn, we will mow while you are at work. Let us know about locked gates, dogs or anything fragile in the yard. We send a quick message when the job is done and leave the place tidy.

faqs.q: Can I get a one-off cut before an inspection in Kambah?
faqs.a: Yes. One-off mowing, edging and a tidy-up before a rental inspection, open home or end of lease is a common request in Kambah and across Tuggeranong. Quotes are free and upfront, and we take the clippings away with us.
